system.description:
Your off-hand attack no longer suffers Disadvantage. The same feat as in the Martial Path; you can only take it once.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, Monks, and Artificers.

rules.value: Two-Weapon Fighting: your off-hand attack has no Disadvantage.
